articles.summary: Woking, UK, May 5, 2026 – Linde (Nasdaq: LIN) today announced it has been included in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices (previously known as Dow Jones Sustainability Indices) for the 23rd consecutive year.
articles.title: Linde Earns Dow Jones Best-in-Class and S&P Global Recognition for Sustainability Leadership

articles.summary: Woking, UK, May 1, 2026 – Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) today reported its first quarter 2026 financial results.
articles.title: Linde Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
